title: Interpreter, imports and native dependency boundaries
summary: A process interpreter prefix, import path and loaded modules determine actual runtime environment. Static package metadata cannot prove native extension ABI, loader libraries, import-name mapping or which environment an existing service uses.
checks: Correlate trusted application instrumentation for process interpreter identity and an authoritative functional oracle.
Check OS library and architecture compatibility through a separately approved read-only collector.
limitations: No target-controlled Python, pip, modules or entry points are executed; runtime behavior remains unmeasured.
applicability: POSIX CPython venv metadata for Python 3.11-3.14; static evidence only
